SALAH_DETAIL.TITLE: Prayer Details
SALAH_DETAIL.NO_RAKATS: No rakaat details configured for this time block.

sahri.REMINDER_BODY: Take suhoor, for there is blessing in the pre-dawn meal.

fajr.TIME_TEXT: From true dawn (Subh Sadiq) until just before sunrise.
fajr.REMINDER_BODY: The two rakahs before Fajr are better than the world and all it contains.

tulu.REMINDER_BODY: Use this time for reflection and remembrance after the night worship ends.

ishraq.REMINDER_BODY: Who remembers Allah after Fajr and then prays after sunrise earns great reward.

chast.NOTE: Minimum 2 rak'ah, and more may be prayed in pairs.
chast.REMINDER_BODY: Duha prayer is a charity on every joint of the body and a sign of gratitude.

zawal.REMINDER_BODY: Pause at this time and prepare the heart for the coming prayer of Dhuhr.

dhuhr.TIME_TEXT: After zawal (sun passes zenith) until Asr.
dhuhr.REMINDER_BODY: Guard the middle prayer with care and stand before Allah with devotion.

asr.TIME_TEXT: From late afternoon until just before sunset.
asr.REMINDER_BODY: Whoever preserves the Asr prayer protects one of the most emphasized daily prayers.

gurub.REMINDER_BODY: As the sun sets, renew remembrance and prepare for Maghrib without delay.

iftar.REMINDER_BODY: The fasting person has a supplication at iftar that is not turned away.

maghrib.TIME_TEXT: Just after sunset until twilight disappears.
maghrib.REMINDER_BODY: Hasten to Maghrib when its time enters and welcome the evening with prayer.

awabin.REMINDER_BODY: Extra prayer after Maghrib is a beautiful way to continue turning back to Allah.

isha.TIME_TEXT: After twilight disappears until midnight (or before Fajr).
isha.NOTE: Witr after Isha: 3 rak'ah, commonly prayed as 2 + 1 with salam in between.
isha.REMINDER_BODY: Praying Isha in congregation carries immense reward and closes the day in worship.

tahajjud.TIME_TEXT: After Isha, preferably last third of night, before Fajr.
tahajjud.NOTE: Minimum 2 rak'ah, and more may be prayed in pairs.
tahajjud.REMINDER_BODY: The best prayer after the obligatory prayers is the night prayer.

jumuah.REMINDER_BODY: Prepare early for the khutbah and congregational prayer, and honor the blessings of Friday.

aboutUs.title: About Salah Time
aboutUs.subtitle: A visual guide for the five daily Salah timings, calculated based on the sun's position.
aboutUs.description: Salah Time calculates all five daily Salah timings using precise astronomical methods based on your location, date, and the sun's position:
aboutUs.fajr: Fajr: Begins at dawn when the first light appears on the horizon, calculated using a specific angle of the sun below the horizon.
aboutUs.dhuhr: Dhuhr: Starts when the sun reaches its highest point in the sky (solar noon).
aboutUs.asr: Asr: Begins when an object's shadow becomes equal to or twice its length, depending on the selected madhab (Hanafi or standard).
aboutUs.maghrib: Maghrib: Begins immediately after the sun sets below the horizon, with an optional short extension for twilight periods.
aboutUs.isha: Isha: Starts when night fully sets in, calculated either with a fixed time after Maghrib or based on the sun's angle below the horizon.
aboutUs.footer: Additional adjustments can be applied for each Salah to account for local conventions or personal preferences. By combining astronomical calculations, location, and time offsets, Salah Time ensures accurate timings for every day of the year, anywhere in the world.
